_meta.scope: Selected public/open-air and ordinary managed-location leads from Germany, UK, Netherlands, Finland, Sweden, France, Switzerland and Spain. Not an exhaustive site or country crawl. Follow-up: selected public/ordinary leads for Bruges, Salzburg, Florence, Bologna, Verona, Edinburgh, Lucerne, Seville, Granada; Naples Italy rejected due to US name collision.
limitations: Many 'cruising area' pages are misclassified bars, hotels, retail stores, charities or event venues. Dedicated nightlife and sex-business sites were omitted.

A few geographic assignments are incorrect (e.g. an Assateague Island beach from Maryland filed under Berlin, London Ontario sites under London England, and Paris Texas sites under France). Check actual physical location.
Some city landing pages and individual detail pages timed out or were inaccessible, but indexed content or the category pages exposed names and location descriptions.
Some source pages say 'verified' in 2026 while older variants have decades-old text; recent indexing or a badge alone does not independently validate current activity.
Never collect member locations, profiles, check-ins, messages or real-time activity.
Edinburgh's city category notes update dating to September 2012; no recent active status established.
Some detail URLs could not be opened, but their names and category snippets were available on public city index pages.
Florence/Firenze duplicates and same park corridor were linked rather than counted repeatedly.
